thread:
anya (support): heads up: multiple customers in eu-central and us-west reporting elevated 504s and aborted streams since ~18:03 UTC. Support queue full. Opening thread. thread_ts=1968765432

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-1968765432. Paging eng oncall.

drew (eng-runtime): I can see spikes in request latency from the model-side workers starting at 18:01. There's also a surge of CONNECTs that drop after 20-30s with no response. Sample request IDs: r_7012a3, r_7012b4.

liam (eng-gateway): gateway logs: `upstream reset` and `read timeout` patterns. Nginx proxy showing large keepalive backlog. Memory on gateway nodes okay but connection counts are high. Looking for correlation with auth service.

nora (eng-sre): checking metrics: streaming p99 token latency up x6, 504s climbing to 6% in eu-central. Autoscaler didn't spin immediately because controller saw short-lived high CPU but not sustained.

anya (support): one customer (beta-ml) says requests succeed when they retry after 60s. They provided a dump of request timelines. They're urgent; asking for ETA.

drew (eng-runtime): tail of runtime stderr: ```ERROR model-session: reload: failed to acquire model lock: timeout waiting for file-descriptor; returning 502 to gateway```  Also seeing file-descriptor exhaustion on a subset of workers. Could be fd leak after the recent model hot-reload feature.

liam (eng-gateway): if workers are returning 502s/giving up connections, gateway opens a lot of proxied sockets, gets backlog. Workaround: reduce worker graceful-retry window so gateway fails fast and falls back to next replica. Applying `proxy_read_timeout 20s` temporarily and increasing upstream retry attempts.

nora (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) cordon and restart affected model-workers to free FDs (rolling over subset) 2) temp bump worker pool in eu-central by +25% 3) throttle heavy streaming clients at gateway 4) roll back hot-reload commit if telemetry confirms.

opsbot: executing: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker -n inference --selector=region=eu-central --grace-period=30`

drew (eng-runtime): restarted first 10 pods; fd counts dropped. Early signs: 504 rate cut by ~40% but still above baseline. Hot-reload PR #1422 touched descriptor caching. Marking it suspect.

liam (eng-gateway): proxy tuning in place (`proxy_read_timeout 20s`, `proxy_next_upstream error timeout`). Watch logs for improved 504->502 ratio.

anya (support): sending customer note: "We're actively mitigating an inference availability issue in eu-central and us-west. We've restarted workers and adjusted gateway timeouts. Expect intermittent 5xx to persist for the next ~30m while we confirm stability. Please share failing request IDs if you see new errors." :email:

sophie (product): need a concise summary for customers & account execs. Also: does this tie to any recent deploys?

nora (eng-sre): deploy audit: a canary for model hot-reload landed at 17:45 and promoted to region targets at 17:59. That matches the onset. Will revert canary to previous revision.

drew (eng-runtime): creating rollback PR to disable hot-reload feature flag in prod config: `feature.hot_reload=false`. Also will push a short-term FD guard: limit open descriptors per-process and fail early with 429 if approaching threshold.

incident-bot: Action item created: ACTION-4320 (rollback hot-reload + immediate FD guard) assigned to drew, due 2026-03-16. ACTION-4321 (gateway timeout safeguard) assigned to liam, due 2026-03-16. ACTION-4322 (autoscaler hysteresis tuning) assigned to nora, due 2026-03-17. ACTION-4323 (customer summary draft) assigned to anya, due 2026-03-15 EOD.

liam (eng-gateway): rolled config change; gateway is now failing faster and retrying upstream. Observed 502->503 conversion, overall 5xx volume down another 30%.

drew (eng-runtime): hot-reload flag switched off for eu-central and us-west. Monitoring. Also added a short-lived guard: `if (open_fds > 8000) return 429`  patch pushed to prod branch.

nora (eng-sre): autoscaler note: current GPU pool controller uses 90s lookback; will reduce to 20s and permit a 2-minute burst to avoid slow reaction to rapid traffic spikes.

anya (support): customer update sent: "Issue mitigated; we've disabled a new hot-reload feature and restarted workers. We'll follow up with a root-cause summary and timeline." Accounts asked for postmortem.

opsbot: Incident status -> mitigated. War room closing, leaving thread for postmortem follow-ups.

nora (eng-sre): postmortem follow-ups (initial): - Investigate FD leak in hot-reload module (owner: drew) - Add canary perf test for fd usage under concurrency (owner: drew) - Reduce autoscaler lookback and add emergency burst toggle (owner: nora) - Update runbook to include gateway fast-fail toggle (owner: liam) - Customer-facing RCA (owner: anya). Please add any items by EOD. :memo:
